integrity: The theorem separates the previously published minimum-weight value from the new complete optimum classification, count and orbit statement. The exact proof is combinatorial; finite test ranges are explicitly bounded. External independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only finite simple labeled cycles of order at least three are classified; no enumeration of nonminimum functions, different Roman variants or arbitrary graphs is asserted. Literature priority may change with unindexed sources.
title: Rotational rigidity and exact optimal-labeling census for restrained double Roman domination on cycles
